title: DeepSeek AI Infrastructure and Founding Architecture

chunks.text: DeepSeek AI is an artificial intelligence research laboratory founded by Liang Wenfeng in Hangzhou, China. Prior to founding DeepSeek in 2023, Liang Wenfeng founded High-Flyer Quant (Zhejiang Jiuzhang Asset Management) in 2015, a quantitative hedge fund that pioneered algorithmic and deep learning strategies for financial markets.

entities.name: Liang Wenfeng
entities.description: Founder of DeepSeek AI and High-Flyer Quant

chunks.text: To support intense computational requirements, High-Flyer Quant engineered and deployed the Fire-Flyer 2 supercomputing cluster. The Fire-Flyer 2 cluster integrates over 10,000 PCIe-connected GPUs interconnected with high-throughput 200 Gbps InfiniBand fabrics, providing the foundational compute backbone later leveraged by DeepSeek for distributed model training.

title: DeepSeek Architecture Innovations: MLA and DualPipe

chunks.text: DeepSeek-V3 introduced Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), a compression architecture that projects Key-Value matrices into low-dimensional latent vectors during inference. By compressing the KV cache by over 93% compared to standard Multi-Head Attention, MLA allows DeepSeek-V3 to serve 128k context windows with dramatically reduced GPU memory footprints.

relations.description: Introduced MLA to compress inference KV cache

chunks.text: To achieve efficient distributed scaling across the Fire-Flyer 2 infrastructure, DeepSeek engineered DualPipe, an overlapping pipeline parallelism algorithm. DualPipe overlaps forward and backward computation bubbles with cross-node communication phases, slashing pipeline latency bubbles by 50% compared to 1F1B scheduling.
